title: Hudson x David weekly
notes_markdown:
### Synthesis so far (Elena + Priya + 3 earlier calls)

- Everyone has a tool graveyard; all quit "organize up front" tools
- The words people use: "lose", "find again", "which chat", "the real reason" — nobody said "provenance" except us
- AI chats are now a primary source of ideas for both Berkeley interviewees, and neither can search them well
- Strong pull: tracing a claim back to its origin (Elena: methods section; Priya: "the third reason")
- Strong worry: wrong summaries (Elena) and duplicates (Priya)

### Product implications

- Show originals, not summaries — the trail should open the actual chat turn / memo heading
- Claude Projects must import with project membership (Priya)
- Dedupe across Zotero / Downloads / Slack files is a launch requirement, not polish
- Some sources are restricted (IRB data) → per-source opt-out at connect time, and say what was skipped
- Photo/handwritten notes: real but out of scope

### Lena update (Thu)

- Conversations this week: 5 (hit the target for the first time)
- Metric still not measurable; pilot build target Oct 5

### Action items

- [ ] David — Ben Adeyemi call tomorrow (Zoom, 11:00)
- [ ] Hudson — tag all quotes in the sheet; count per tag
- [ ] David — spec "trail opens the original" for the canvas
- [ ] Hudson — check whether Claude export includes project membership
